Opened by the scheduled PyPI bump. Each formula below now points at the newest
sdist on PyPI, with its resource blocks regenerated by
`brew update-python-resources`.

**Land this with Actions → brew pr-pull, not the merge button.** The bottle
block is deliberately absent: `pr-pull` is what collects the bottles this pull
request's CI built and writes them back into the formula. Merging normally
publishes a formula with no bottles on any platform, and every user then
builds from source.
